name: Uyeda Jun
source:
A time-worn lady, she has been treated like dirt all her life by her husband, and now that she is single, she lives alone, drinking at night in her house while during the day she tries to earn money to maintain the luxurious life of her daughter who lives abroad on the sly.

[In game description]
